documents: SQLite transactions commit all changes atomically. A rollback leaves the previous durable state intact.
A note keeps its stable identity when it is renamed or moved to another folder. Its history follows that identity.
Remote work meetings happen at 09:00 Mountain time. Daylight saving changes the offset from UTC.
The pasta sauce uses roasted tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and fresh basil. Simmer it for twenty minutes.
The image viewer displays local PNG and JPEG files embedded in Markdown notes. Dragging an image imports it into assets.
Keyword search stays available while the semantic embedding model downloads and its index rebuilds.
The application shuts down its owned child processes and waits for them to exit before closing the vault.
Remembered passage: We decided to use blue for the search button because it stood out against the dark background.
Remembered passage: The client said the packaging must be submitted by Friday, and Alice owns the proof review.
A failed model upgrade preserves the old database generation and model files so the previous provider can restart.
